digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite verification gate, code-review LLM-Review gate
propositions: Bedrock returns HTTP 400 ValidationException with 'Grammar compilation timed out' or 'Schema is too complex' when rebar sends JSON Schema for constrained decoding on contracts with 22-36 optional parameters, hitting Anthropic's 180-second compilation timeout

Story 18ae's exact-model-id row setting native_structured_output=True for sonnet-4-6 flips the model from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput, causing rebar to send previously-unprompted schemas to Bedrock for compilation
Every plan-review and code-review finding degrades to no-verification when prerequisite_verify fails, rendering the review INDETERMINATE and unsigned, blocking ticket claims

The failure is deterministic (27 identical ~185s timeouts across ~9 review targets), reproducible with small-contract+NATIVE→OK vs large-contract+NATIVE→FAIL vs large-contract+PROMPTED→OK (proven serially, single-variable)

output_mode must gate NativeOutput on both schema complexity (measured bound 16 optional / 12 union parameters) and runtime stack capability (outputConfig parameter support), falling back to PromptedOutput when either constraint is exceeded
